text_block_list.text: The day has finally come to reclaim my honor.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I've reflected upon the insufficiencies I displayed during my last race and spent days and days working hard since…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Please watch assured of my victory!
